_comment: Icon ids -> texture, name, palette color and the plain lines a tooltip shows. Every stat, resource, status, intent, map action, region property and personality trait has one; screens name icons by id (UiIcons.texture("atk")), never by path. Text may name glossary keywords (data/ui/glossary.json); the tooltip highlights them. TODO(decision: ui-style-icon-art): every texture is generated placeholder art (tools/asset_gen/).

def.name: Defense
def.text: Takes this much off every hit.

spd.name: Speed
spd.text: Higher speed acts sooner on the timeline.

battery.name: Battery
battery.text: Most Energy this bot can hold in a fight.

ela.name: Elasticity
ela.text: Springs back from big hits. Not used in fights yet.

energy.name: Energy
energy.text: A bot's power in a fight. Skills spend it; it refills over time.

map_energy.name: Energy
map_energy.text: The campaign's stockpile of power. Map actions spend it.

grid_power.name: Grid power
grid_power.text: Power from the regions you hold.

material.name: Material
material.text: From held regions and won fights. Pays for Breach and Repair.

time.name: Time
time.text: Days left before the countdown ends.

defense_level.name: Defense level
defense_level.text: How strongly a region is held. Higher means tougher enemies.

pressure.name: Pressure
pressure.text: How hard the enemy pushes back. Rises over time.

alert.name: Alert
alert.text: How much the enemy has noticed you. Higher tiers send stronger forces.

fortify.name: Fortified
fortify.text: Defense this region built while left alone on Alert. Attack it to stop the digging.

losses.name: Losses
losses.text: Battles lost this act, over the limit. At the limit the run ends.

regions.name: Regions held
regions.text: Regions you hold out of all on the map.

action_reinforce.name: Reinforce
action_reinforce.text: Lower the Pressure on a region you hold.

action_retreat.name: Retreat
action_retreat.text: Back out before the fight starts. No fight, no loss.

action_fast_forward.name: Fast-forward
action_fast_forward.text: Play the days to the payload. Stops for a forced defense.

action_breach.name: Breach
action_breach.text: Break the defenses first: fight at a lower Defense level.

action_repair.name: Repair
action_repair.text: Restore grid capacity. Takes no time.

action_cancel.name: Cancel
action_cancel.text: Drop the chosen skill and pick again.

action_home.name: Main menu
action_home.text: Back to the main menu. A run is saved first; Continue picks it up.

action_resume.name: Resume
action_resume.text: Close this menu and play on.

action_settings.name: Settings
action_settings.text: Volume, screen shake, motion and animation speed.

action_replay.name: Replay
action_replay.text: Play this demo again from its start.

demo_map.name: Map
demo_map.text: A demo on the act's map.

demo_globe.name: Globe
demo_globe.text: A demo on the world globe.

intent_attack.name: Attack
intent_attack.text: Will attack for this much damage.

intent_charge.name: Charge
intent_charge.text: Will Charge up for a bigger move.

intent_buff.name: Buff
intent_buff.text: Will strengthen itself or an ally.

status_guard.name: Guard
status_guard.text: Blocks part of the next hits.

status_low_energy.name: Low Energy
status_low_energy.text: Cannot afford any skill that costs Energy.

ko.name: KO
ko.text: This hit would put its target Down.

more.name: More
more.text: Opens the full card: every stat, skill and note.

odds.name: Odds
odds.text: Chance to win, from simulated fights.

elite.name: Elite
elite.text: A stronger enemy than its kind.

guide.name: How to play
guide.text: A short guide to a run, the map and fights.
